correctness.rationale: Productive updates have P(K->K±e_i)=K_i/(2M) for M=sum leaf counts until absorption. The aggregate M is a fair gambler ruin chain. Pathwise predecessor sums preserve equal mass on positive count vectors conditional on aggregate trajectory; extinction cannot reverse. Product H=prod_i K_i is bounded harmonic martingale and its optional-stopping expectation is one. The weighted composition sum [z^n](z/(1-z)^2)^r=binom(n+r-1,2r-1) normalizes each positive terminal probability. Independent exact rational Markov-chain calculations on (r,n)=(3,4),(3,5),(3,6),(4,5) agree. Unlimited result relies on pathwise proof, not these cases.
